assessments.finding: The 37db6395 pin in accepted P01 requirements, event-review contract and original S03 is dated October17. Client qualification cites a79e21d9 dated October5. Calling the S03 citation older was incorrect.

The sole change adds the relay subscription rule that an empty list condition matches no events; it must not act as an omitted condition. No event schema, serialization, signature, tag, timestamp or kind rule changes between these two pins.

S03 is the bounded event-template parser, canonical operation/review and consuming local authorization boundary. It does not implement relay REQ filter matching. The complete NIP01 delta therefore adds no S03 behavior/vector requirement.

All twelve other listed NIPs have byte-identical Git blob identities between the two source trees, including kind1 reference/quote and NIP07/44/46 workflows. This is byte comparison against previously reviewed inputs, not a new complete semantic review.
